anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.cache_rate_source: anthropic published prompt-caching multipliers applied to this entry's own cost_in_per_mtok: cache read 0.10x, 1h-TTL cache write 2.00x. billed_cache_write_tokens collapses the 1h and 5m TTLs into one column, so pricing every cache write at the 1h rate is an explicit lossy convention, not a reconstruction of any session's TTL; 1h is the ratified one because this task's acceptance figures require it and because both sampled b168-paneusage claude-opus-5 pane seats used only 1h writes.
